name: assets_count_signature
description: REQ-817 / GH #4374 (asset count K2, D-128). One row per signer of a count document: the chair records that the person signed the printout on paper (the system does not verify the signature). Append-only: no function of module assets updates or deletes a row. document_kind is sheet now; result is declared for K4 so that slice needs no enum widening. count_order_id is a real foreign key onto assets_count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column. document_id and version_no name the issued document version that was signed.
